# Demand Forecasting Analysis

::: {.hero-lead}
A machine learning forecasting project designed to improve demand and inventory planning for a large retail chain.
:::

::: {.metrics-grid}
::: {.detail-card}
### Objective
Improve planning accuracy across 45 stores.
:::

::: {.detail-card}
### Methods
XGBoost forecasting with seasonality and promotion-aware features, benchmarked against a time-series baseline.
:::

::: {.detail-card}
### Outcome
Reduced WAPE from about 10% to 3%.
:::
:::
:::

:::{.section-row}
<div class="section-label">Overview</div>

This work focused on building a more reliable retail demand view so operational decisions could reflect seasonality and promotional effects more effectively.
:::
